map.财务（收支/报表/审计）管理 使用指南: Finance (Income and Expense / Statements / Audit) Management User Guide
map.物业财务收支、报表与审计管理工具按通用财务规则核算经营收支并生成报表，适合物业公: The Property Finance Income, Expenses, Statements and Audit Management tool accounts for operating income and expenses under general financial rules and generates statements, which suits the accounting and compliance audit of a property management company.
map.物业会计按月出具收支表（物业费、停车、维修支出）: A property management office issues a monthly income and expense statement (management fees, parking, repairs)
map.业主大会前编制年度财务报告并接受审计: Prepare the annual financial report before the owners' meeting and have it audited
map.监管抽查时快速导出银行流水与台账对照: Quickly export bank statements and ledgers for comparison during a spot check
map.：收入：物业费 18 万 + 停车 4.5 万 + 其他 1 万 = 23.5: Income: management fees 180,000 + parking 45,000 + other 10,000 = 235,000; expenses: staff 120,000 + energy 30,000 + repairs 20,000 + management 20,000 = 190,000 → a surplus of 45,000.
map.：银行入账 23.5 万与账面收入一致、支出有发票支撑 → 通过；差异项（0.3: A bank receipt of 235,000 matching the book income and expenses supported by invoices → passes; the difference (30,000 of prepaid deposit) is carried separately and not counted as income.
map.物业财务报告必须审计吗？: Must the property financial report be audited?
map.业主大会可决议审计；各地多要求公共收益单独建账、定期公示。: The owners' meeting can resolve to have an audit carried out; most places require common income to be kept in separate accounts and published regularly.
map.预收的物业费算当期收入吗？: Does prepaid management fee count as current period income?
map.不算，按服务期分期确认；预收押金、保证金更不能计入收入。: Not counted; recognise it over the service period, and prepaid deposits or earnest money must never be counted as income at all.
